title: Post-tag: audit the src/git.ts reads for silent empty results with a larger node run
description: Follow-up under opum-doc DEC-299 (a5) clarification and ruling (arm A): the GCLI-56 node measurement found zero exit-0-empty reads in 1500 git reads (60 runs x 2 commands, packed dist/glyph.js, node 24.22.2, 150 busy loops), upper bound about 2e-3 per read at 95%. The src/git.ts reads (gitRun, ls-files, cat-file --batch) were exercised by that run but not guarded. Audit them and rerun the same harness larger (about 400 runs, about 2.5 hours on a loaded Mac) with the positive control. Post-tag; NOT STARTED. The harness and wrapper live in the GCLI-56 session scratchpad and are described in the GCLI-56 notes; rebuild them from that description if gone. Name the ls-tree read explicitly: src/snapshot.ts reads a commit's tree through gitRun, and tier 3's loader catch in src/codemap.ts turns any error into index=null, which is silent by design, so an empty ls-tree there is not a visible failure.

acceptanceCriteria.text: every git read in src/git.ts is listed with whether empty is legitimate or contradicts a held precondition
a larger node run (about 400 runs) of the packed dist/glyph.js under load with a positive control is recorded with its counts and detectable rate
if any exit-0-empty read is observed, a guarded fix lands with tests both ways and mutation proofs
